aries.horoscope: 今天是個轉捩點，因為您將解決並消除一直困擾您的那些小煩惱。您的耐心可能快要耗盡了，因此明智的做法是遠離那些讓您感到不快的朋友。此外，當您捨棄不再合身或不再符合您風格的衣服時，您會發現衣櫃煥然一新。
aries.horoscope_en: Today marks a turning point as you tackle and eliminate the minor annoyances that have been weighing on your mind. Your patience may be running thin, so it’s wise to steer clear of friends who have been getting under your skin. Additionally, you'll find a refreshing upgrade to your wardrobe as you let go of clothes that no longer fit or reflect your style.

taurus.horoscope_en: While you typically handle setbacks with ease, today calls for a more assertive approach to any endeavors you embark on. It's crucial to adopt a focused mindset, particularly when it comes to financial matters. By implementing a structured strategy, you'll not only save your energy but also protect your resources.

gemini.horoscope_en: Today, Gemini, you may find yourself caught in a tug-of-war between two contrasting desires. One part of you craves the comfort of solitude, indulging in your favorite pastimes. Meanwhile, another aspect of your personality is eager to take the lead on an exciting creative or social project alongside like-minded friends who share your visionary spirit. It’s understandable to feel drained from the effort of trying to create an ideal world.

cancer.horoscope_en: You frequently take on the role of the "organizer." Whether it's your living space or your inner world, you take pleasure in creating a nurturing environment for various new beginnings, both literal and metaphorical. Expect to feel the urge to declutter your surroundings, dispose of items that no longer serve you, tidy up your workspace, or tackle that pile of correspondence. Strong energies are driving you to get ready for an exciting new chapter or a fresh opportunity.

leo.horoscope_en: Today, Leo, embrace spontaneity and take bold steps, particularly when navigating uncharted paths or venturing into new experiences. While it might feel unconventional, today is all about confidently accepting various opportunities that come your way, even if they seem a bit vague. You thrive in these situations, so anticipate finishing the day at the forefront of success!

virgo.horoscope_en: Virgo, it’s clear that you’re facing a significant challenge right now. The remarks about your short temper are not unfounded. However, take heart; those around you will come to understand and forgive you in time. In the interim, focus on managing your frustrations, as they are rooted in your growing anxieties. Remember, the cosmic forces at play are influencing your emotions, so view this as an opportunity for personal growth and self-discovery.

libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, you might find yourself feeling particularly bold and daring. Recently, you've been on the lookout for a way to channel all that vibrant energy you've been blessed with. Well, today is your chance, as exciting new projects are likely to present themselves. By confronting your inner fears, you can uncover a remarkable opportunity to let go of the burdens that have weighed you down for far too long.

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，您的內心激情一直在表面下蠢蠢欲動，渴望釋放出來。今天是釋放這些激情的好時機。雖然您的一些坦白可能會讓別人措手不及，甚至面臨批評，但不要讓這些阻礙您前進。壓抑自己的感受可能會導致情緒或身體上的不適。專注於忠於真實的自己；這是獲得真正幸福與健康的關鍵。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Scorpio, your inner passions have been bubbling beneath the surface, eager to break free. Today is the perfect moment to unleash them. While some of your revelations might catch others off guard or even face criticism, don’t let that hold you back. Keeping your feelings bottled up could lead to emotional or physical discomfort. Focus on being authentic to who you are; this is the key to achieving true happiness and well-being.

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，今天對您來說相當特別！感覺就像您收到了一張前往令人興奮目的地的單程票。出發的時間快到了，幾乎沒有機會準備或道別。每一秒都很重要！雖然旅程的刺激讓您著迷，但仍有一絲不安揮之不去。不過，星象顯示，擁抱這場冒險將為您帶來豐厚的回報。 抵達後，別忘了寄明信片給親朋好友！
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today is quite peculiar for you, Sagittarius! It feels as though you've received a one-way ticket to an exciting destination. The time to leave is fast approaching, and there's little opportunity to prepare or bid farewell. Every second counts! While the thrill of the journey captivates you, a hint of apprehension lingers. However, the stars suggest that embracing this adventure will bring you great rewards. Don't forget to drop a postcard to your friends and family once you arrive!

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，隨著一天接近尾聲，您會發現自己正在回顧這相當不平凡的一天。您的腦海中充滿了創意想法，像雨後春筍般不斷湧現。也許您曾想像過踏上一場說走就走的全球冒險，設計出一款聰明的新型家用小工具，或是在數位領域構想出一個全新的機會。別把這些想法當成空想就擱置一旁；它們蘊含著真正的潛力。
capricorn.horoscope_en: As the day wraps up, Capricorn, you'll find yourself reflecting on a rather extraordinary day. Your mind has been buzzing with creative thoughts, sprouting like mushrooms after rain. Perhaps you envisioned embarking on a spontaneous global adventure, devised a clever new household gadget, or imagined a fresh opportunity in the digital realm. Don't brush these thoughts aside as mere fantasies; they hold real potential.

pisces.horoscope: 親愛的雙魚座，今天您可能會發現，與親人相處比平時更具挑戰性。大家似乎都繃緊神經，難以表達自己的想法。幸好，您的耐心是您的強項。為了避免可能發生的衝突，不妨考慮暫時離開家裡，遠離與之相關的壓力。離開您平常的環境，您可能會遇到一些人，他們能幫助您平靜心靈，讓您感到平靜。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today, dear Pisces, you may find that your loved ones are a bit more challenging than usual. It seems like everyone is on edge and struggling to express themselves. Thankfully, your patience is your strong suit. To prevent any potential flare-ups, consider steering clear of home and its associated stress. By stepping away from your usual surroundings, you might encounter individuals who can help soothe your spirit and bring you a sense of tranquility.
